chrome_storage_local_role: non-authoritative UI preferences, lightweight resume hints, never Registry/Ledger truth
commit_transaction: single IndexedDB readwrite transaction over registry + events + runs + accepted_messages as applicable
recovery: all controllers are restartable; rehydrate FSM from IndexedDB after extension page/service-worker suspension or reload
ui_lifetime_assumption: none; automation.html is UI only and may disappear without invalidating authoritative run state
